description: Lists locally owned places in Milwaukee County within a radius of a latitude and longitude, nearest first and at most 50, with the straight-line distance in meters and each place's canonical page URL, and the neighborhood the point is in (nearest_neighborhood). Filters by category, tags (every tag must match) and kind. Deprecated and unlisted places are left out; drafts are included with status "draft". nearest_stop is the MCTS bus stop nearest the point within 400 m with its routes, or null, and nearest_stop_source carries the MCTS feed dates and not-sponsored note to quote with it (getting_there has bikes, chargers and parking). A tag outside the vocabulary returns { "error": "invalid_input" }.

category.description: Only places in this category slug, for example kids.

kind.description: Only places of this kind: place (a business or public place) or organization (a group or company).

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, for example 42.9908.

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, for example -87.9010.

radius_m.description: Search radius in meters, default 1500; values above 10000 search 10000.

tags.description: Only places that carry every one of these tag slugs, as a list or one comma-separated string, for example patio,live-music. list_tags returns the vocabulary.

name: places_near
